package decision_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/decision"
)

type sequenceIDs struct {
	values []string
}

func (generator *sequenceIDs) NewID() string {
	value := generator.values[0]
	generator.values = generator.values[1:]
	return value
}

type fixedClock time.Time

func (clock fixedClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Time(clock) }

type decisionRecorder struct {
	decision domain.TeacherDecision
	event    domain.IntegrationEvent
	err      error
}

func (recorder *decisionRecorder) Record(_ context.Context, recorded domain.TeacherDecision, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	recorder.decision = recorded
	recorder.event = event
	return recorder.err
}

func TestRecordPersistsDecisionAndEventTogether(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := &decisionRecorder{}
	ids := &sequenceIDs{values: []string{"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"}}
	uc := decision.Record{
		Decisions: recorder,
		IDs:       ids,
		Clock:     fixedClock(time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)),
	}

	recorded, err := uc.Execute(context.Background(), decision.RecordInput{
		PersonalTeacherID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
		StudentID:         "student-1",
		CorrelationID:     "request-1",
		TeachingMode:      domain.TeachingModeLesson,
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID:         "lesson-1",
		PedagogyMethod:    domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode,
		PedagogyVersion:   domain.ProgressiveHintMethodVersion,
		PedagogyStage:     domain.AMCDOrient,
		Strategy:          "adaptive_explanation",
		Action:            domain.TeacherActionRespond,
		ReasonCode:        "student_question",
		ReasonSummary:     "The student requested clarification for the active lesson.",
		PolicyVersion:     "teaching-policy.v1",
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", recorded.ID)
	require.Equal(t, recorded, recorder.decision)
	require.Equal(t, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", recorder.event.EventID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, recorder.event.Subject)
	require.Equal(t, recorded.StudentID, recorder.event.StudentID)
}
